verdict.rationale: No evidence describes exporting Unity project data (scenes, assets, asset database) into open, portable formats for leaving the platform; documentation instead shows assets are imported/optimized into Unity's own internal format (unity-docs-12, unity-docs-29), and no llms.txt/data-export tooling was found (unity-probe-1, unity-probe-2). Missing for 10: any documented data-export/portability feature, open-format guarantees, or independent confirmation of lock-in-free migration.
